name: Minami Kanako
source: The protagonist's classmate. She is very timid around most people. She is caught taking sexy pictures of self in the classroom by protag. At first she is half-assed blackmailed to be a model to take pics, but she turns it down and he gives up. But she then changes her mind when she hears the protag is passionate to be a photographer and she wouldn't have to do anything naughty.
